notes.title: Hotfix 1.1.8
notes.content:
We were able to successfully integrate a new input system so all 8 players should be able to play now on Windows 10/11.

Get those blobs back in the fight!

notes.title: Hotfix Notes - 1.1.7
notes.content:
A bug was identified preventing players from playing the game at all, being unable to join the customization screen.

We have applied a temporary fix to input [b]so up to 4 players can now play[/b]. This happened because behind the scenes Microsoft updated their controller drivers and it broke the older system we were using.

We are working towards a fix for the total of 8 players, but at least this way smaller groups can play the game at this time.

notes.title: Mob Blobs have arrived!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32530530/141f39d82501aeedad4711b5783401b74cf623db.png[/img]

[h1]Mob Blobs is the first PvE mode in the game, and we're super excited to battle the mobs along side you![/h1]

It breaks down like so:
[list]
[*] Play lone wolf, or with up to 7 other friends locally
[*] Cooperatively defend your zone from the attacking mobs, if they reach the zone it will take damage. If your zones are destroyed, you lose.
[*] Periodically the zones will shuffle around, so stay on your toes to keep them safe.
[*] Play on one of the two new maps Magma and Grid, with a third on the way!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32530530/4198f43e02f1ec66c59bb77099985c46f94adc8c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32530530/2d35b5916c5331a258fba0fcaa26e24f5a98d72b.png[/img]

There are three kinds of mob, the small ones that likely target you and attack, the medium ones that move toward the zone but can be agro'd if attacked, and the big boys that slowly march toward your zone only. All of them will require your entire attacking toolkit to take down.

We've also added in some new costumes, the dinosaur spikes, anime hair, old man hair, cat whiskers and an uncomfortably human nose.

To check out the rest of the changes, see the [url=https://www.skypyre.com/blobs-patches]patch notes[/url].

Hope everyone has a great day, and fight on!
- SkyPyre Team

notes.title: Update 1.1.3 - Bull Update!
notes.content:
With the end of the winter season, the limited time winter maps have thawed, but one of the warmer maps has had a complete retexture! Much like skate, we wanted to improve the quality of the visuals on Bull, and so we've 2.0'd it!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32530530/bd8df0e2960ff9d7015162784f253ad144e364bc.jpg[/img]

Other additions:
[list]
[*]The costume additions from the Winter update are here to stay!
[*]There is now a respawn timer for game modes with respawning 
[/list]

For more on patch notes click [url=https://www.skypyre.com/blobs-patches]here[/url]

Until next time, take care!

- SkyPyre Team

notes.title: Skate Update Live! - 1.1.1
notes.content:
We've added some really cool new features to Blobs with this update, and of course the titular Skate upgrade! Skate has received an entire revamp, from the ground up. The map has a new fresh look, more dynamic gameplay, and allows for some new moves - hint; try dashing into the ramps!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32530530/8bc6c5289f6d337d524f1fbc6d4a6a0b39ef614a.jpg[/img]

Some other features we've added are:
[list]
[*] Camera shake during combat - really adds the umph we wanted you to feel.
[*] Taunt by pressing the B button in-game.
[*] Randomize your costume by holding the Y button!
[*] You can now use the D-Pad to navigate the costume menu.
[/list]

For more detailed patch notes click [url=https://www.skypyre.com/blobs-patches]here[/url].

Enjoy the new map and let us know what you'd like to see in the game!

Until next time, take care.

- SkyPyre Team

notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32530530/12da510efa333ca7a9124a48ed31a91285fe8b6e.jpg[/img]

A new and big update has hit Blobs! A major overhaul of the UI (User Interface) brings a much more responsive, easy to use menu system, as well as some in game changes. Major changes:
[list]
[*]New, more fluid menu transitions
[*]Clearer buttons in costume menu
[*]Improved and more accurate defend effects
[*]Use the D-Pad to navigate menus
[*]You have to slam to activate buttons on Castle
[*]Sewer map has had a visual overhaul
[/list]
More detailed patch notes [url=https://www.skypyre.com/blobs-patches]click here[/url]

We have a number of other updates in the pipe as well, such as a complete overhaul of Skate, and several visual updates to other maps and UI elements.

Thank you for your continued support of The Blobs Fight, and until next time, take care!

-SkyPyre Team

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
The first of many more updates to come brings a bunch of small fixes and improvements to the UI, maps, and gameplay. Some highlights:
[list]
[*]Improved zappy floor in Bull
[*]Improved sound menu, and adjusted map volumes
[*]Improved UI navigation
[*]Reduced Laser map size by 30%
[*]Fixed several map collision issues
[/list]
More detailed patch notes [url=https://www.skypyre.com/blobs-patches]click here.[/url]

Since we were asked in the comments about updates we thought we should mention it here. We are indeed planning to support the game going forward, releasing patches, fixing bugs, balancing gameplay, and adding new content and features. So keep an eye on our social media to get sneak peaks on the latest going-ons behind the scenes!

Until next time, happy fighting!

-SkyPyre Team

notes.title: Who's ready to fight!
notes.content:
We're proud to announce that The Blobs Fight goes live tonight at 8:00 PM (ET)! The game took us almost a year to develop, and we learnt a great deal in the process. As indies, we're able to make the game we want to experience, and because of this we hope you'll love it too!

Everyone at SkyPyre is a huge fan of local multiplayer games, the kind that bring us back to our childhoods, with all the victories and defeats that entails. Our goal was to make a fun, engaging, and hilarious beat-em-up that anyone could enjoy with friends, and with 8 players supported, hopefully no one gets left out.

Thank you for stopping by and checking the game out, thank you to all of our fans for the support we received while developing the game, and a very special thank you to those of you who pick up The Blobs Fight!

- SkyPyre Team
